name: Bespoke Nimble 9B
summary: A 9B decision model from Bespoke Labs; under 100 ms per answer on an M5 Max MacBook Pro (Ollama page). Decision model: it answers typed questions (yes/no, choice, score) with probabilities through a Jev-compatible /v1/systemone endpoint. It does not chat or write text.

practical_baseline.reason: Decision models are not ranked by the chat-model baseline policy; pick by hardware and API.
